AWPTCM-T37861.objective:
• LLDP max power values sent to the switch are recognised and can override the port's classification-based max power.
  • CLI configuration of interface max power takes precedence over (overrides) any LLDP-provided max power value.
  • When the CLI interface max power setting is removed, the switch reverts to using the LLDP-provided max power.
  • PoE power delivery and status reporting accurately reflect the effective max power in use (from CLI or LLDP).

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary: AWP-4577 (POE - lldp max power and cli power). Top relevant: AWP-4576 (lldp max power recognised), AWP-4575 (cli interface max power), AWP-14385 (change max power), AWP-5657 (Extended Power TLV). ART: 1358 (PoE status reporting via show power-inline, priorities, disable/enable, HANP) + LLDP TLV suites (e.g. 1332).
Connect a device running LLDP script via POE Load box. Send various LLDP max power values. Verify that LLDP max power is recognised and overrides classification power.
Configure selection of max power values from CLI on the interface. Verify that CLI overrides the LLDP max power value.
Remove the CLI interface max power setting. Verify that the switch reverts to the LLDP-provided max power.
Verify PoE status (show power-inline) and delivery accurately reflect the currently effective max power source (CLI or LLDP).
